decisions.title: The New Mexico 2040 Plan
decisions.description: Preserves NMDOT's previous statewide long-range multimodal plan, establishing goals, performance measures, strategies, and investment direction for safety, asset condition, mobility, access, stewardship, and accountability through 2040.
decisions.provenance_status: official U.S. Library of Congress preservation copy of an NMDOT publication; original NMDOT project-site links are no longer maintained

decisions.title: New Mexico 2040 Plan — Appendix A: Existing Conditions and Trends
decisions.description: Documents the demographic, economic, travel, freight, aviation, rail, transit, bicycle, pedestrian, highway, safety, environmental, and funding conditions used to develop the 2040 plan.
decisions.provenance_status: official U.S. Library of Congress preservation copy of an NMDOT publication; original NMDOT project-site links are no longer maintained
decisions.large_file_assessment: The exact file is 37,531,114 bytes (35.79 MiB), unusually large because its 217 pages contain statewide maps, charts, tables, photographs, and technical figures. It is the authoritative Library of Congress preservation copy; no smaller authoritative version was found. Optimization would alter the preserved source. Projected R2 storage after the six-volume batch is 3,308,921,339 bytes.

decisions.title: New Mexico 2040 Plan — Appendix B: Technical Analysis Report
decisions.description: Presents the technical analysis supporting the 2040 plan's goals, performance measures, investment strategies, alternatives, health impacts, multimodal needs, and implementation recommendations.

decisions.title: New Mexico 2040 Plan — Appendix C: Scenario Analysis Report
decisions.description: Evaluates alternative transportation-investment scenarios, revenue assumptions, system conditions, performance outcomes, and policy tradeoffs that informed NMDOT's selected statewide 2040 strategy.
